children: Shares of Zscaler climbed after the company said it's partnering with companies such as Anthropic and Mistral to defend against artificial intelligence-driven attacks.
Shares rose 18% to $229.51 in after-hours trading on Friday. The stock was down 5.3% through market-close, and is down 13% year to date.

Financial terms of the partnership were not disclosed. The cybersecurity platform said it's partnering with AI model providers to both defend against AI driven-attacks, and then help enterprises adopt AI applications and agents.
Zscaler said it will use Anthropic's cyber verification program to advance its own security research. It will also work with Mistral to help European enterprises to use AI for data protection.
